title: Antigen-presenting-cell-associated programs in thymoma-associated myasthenia gravis: public transcriptomic reanalysis and archived cell-model observations.
snippet: Thymoma-associated myasthenia gravis (TAMG) involves a complex thymic immune environment, but tissue antigen-presenting-cell (APC) programs do not by themselves establish a soluble-signal mechanism.
